phrase: Hold on to that.
example: Hold on to that bonding screw. We may need it later.
exampleZh: 把那颗搭接螺丝留着，我们稍后可能会用到。

phrase: Take note of these holes.
example: Take note of these holes before you set the panel in place.
exampleZh: 把配电箱放到位之前，注意这些孔。

phrase: Knock them out.
example: Use a screwdriver and knock them out one at a time.
exampleZh: 用螺丝刀把它们一个一个敲掉。

phrase: Hold it in place.
example: Hold it in place while I start the first screw.
exampleZh: 我开始上第一颗螺丝时，把它扶在位。

phrase: Check to make sure it's plumb.
example: Use a level and check to make sure it's plumb.
exampleZh: 用水平尺检查它是否垂直。

phrase: Draw that screw in a little tighter.
zh: 把那颗螺丝再拧紧一点。
example: The box is still loose, so draw that screw in a little tighter.
exampleZh: 箱体还有点松，把那颗螺丝再拧紧一点。

phrase: Tap it out.
example: Use a flat screwdriver and tap it out with a hammer.
exampleZh: 用一字螺丝刀和锤子把它轻轻敲出来。

phrase: Make sure the screw heads are facing you.
example: Make sure the screw heads are facing you so you can reach them.
exampleZh: 确保螺丝头朝向你，这样你才能够到。

phrase: Tighten up the nut.
example: Hold the connector steady and tighten up the nut.
exampleZh: 扶稳接头，然后把螺母拧紧。

phrase: Tighten each side equally.
example: Tighten each side equally so the clamp stays centered.
exampleZh: 两边均匀拧紧，让卡箍保持居中。

phrase: Draw each side down a little bit at a time.
example: Draw each side down a little bit at a time instead of tightening one side fully.
exampleZh: 每边一次拧紧一点，不要先把一边完全拧紧。

phrase: Flex it down a little bit.
example: Flex it down a little bit so you can reach the jacket.
exampleZh: 把它稍微向下弯，方便处理外皮。

phrase: Strip the casing off carefully.
example: Strip the casing off carefully without touching the conductors.
exampleZh: 小心剥掉外皮，不要伤到导线。

phrase: Score the casing.
example: Score the casing just deep enough to start peeling it back.
exampleZh: 只要轻轻划开外皮，能开始往回剥就行。

phrase: Don't press too hard.
example: Don't press too hard or you'll cut into the wire underneath.
exampleZh: 不要压得太用力，否则会割到下面的电线。

phrase: Start peeling it back.
example: Once the cut is started, start peeling it back.
exampleZh: 切口开好后，开始把外皮往回剥。

phrase: Get the wrapper out of the way.
example: Get the wrapper out of the way before you separate the conductors.
exampleZh: 分开导线前，先把包装纸移开。

phrase: Separate those wires.
example: Separate those wires so each conductor can reach its lug.
exampleZh: 把那些电线分开，让每根导线都能到达对应端子。

phrase: Twist the loose strands together.
zh: 把松散的线股拧在一起。
example: Twist the loose strands together before inserting the conductor.
exampleZh: 插入导线前，把松散的线股拧在一起。

phrase: Mark where it needs to be cut.
example: Hold it where it goes and mark where it needs to be cut.
exampleZh: 把它放到安装位置，然后标出需要剪断的地方。

phrase: Go lightly over it a few times.
example: Go lightly over it a few times instead of making one deep cut.
exampleZh: 轻轻地多划几次，不要一刀切得很深。

phrase: Start prying the casing off.
example: After scoring the plastic, start prying the casing off.
exampleZh: 划过塑料外皮后，开始把它撬下来。

phrase: Loosen the clamp a little.
example: Loosen the clamp a little so the cable can move.
exampleZh: 把卡箍稍微松一点，让电缆可以移动。

phrase: Smear some compound on the cable.
zh: 在电缆上涂一些化合物。
example: Smear some antioxidant compound on the aluminum conductor.
exampleZh: 在铝导线上涂一些抗氧化化合物。

phrase: Slide them up into the lugs.
example: Push the conductors down, then slide them up into the lugs.
exampleZh: 先把导线往下压，再向上插进端子。

phrase: Hold some tension on it.
example: Hold some tension on it while you tighten the lug.
exampleZh: 拧紧端子时，对导线保持一点拉力。

phrase: Snug these up.
example: Make sure the conductors are fully seated, then snug these up.
exampleZh: 确保导线完全到位，然后把这些拧紧。

phrase: Drive the ground rods.
example: Drive the ground rods before you run the bare copper wire.
exampleZh: 铺设裸铜线之前，先把接地棒打入地下。

phrase: Fish it into the house.
example: Connect the wire outside first, then fish it into the house.
exampleZh: 先在室外连好电线，然后把它穿进房子里。

phrase: Back out the bolt.
example: Back out the bolt before sliding the clamp over the rod.
exampleZh: 把卡箍套到接地棒之前，先把螺栓松出来。

phrase: Make a little bend like a hook.
zh: 弯一个像钩子一样的小弯。
example: Make a little bend like a hook so the wire stays against the rod.
exampleZh: 弯一个钩形小弯，让电线贴住接地棒。

phrase: Tighten the clamp down.
example: Position the wire, then tighten the clamp down all the way.
exampleZh: 放好电线，然后把卡箍完全拧紧。

phrase: Don't tighten it until you strip it out.
example: Stop when it is secure. Don't tighten it until you strip it out.
exampleZh: 牢固后就停，不要拧过头导致滑丝。

phrase: Do the same thing on the next one.
zh: 下一个也按同样方法做。
example: That connection is finished. Do the same thing on the next one.
exampleZh: 这个连接完成了，下一个也按同样方法做。

phrase: Don't cut or splice this wire.
zh: 不要剪断或拼接这根线。
example: Keep it as one continuous conductor; don't cut or splice this wire.
exampleZh: 保持它为一根连续导线，不要剪断或拼接。

phrase: Leave it uncovered until inspection.
example: Leave it uncovered until inspection so the inspector can see the connection.
exampleZh: 检查前先不要覆盖，让检查员能看到连接。

phrase: Fish the ground wire into the lug.
example: Back out the lug, then fish the ground wire into it.
exampleZh: 松开端子，然后把接地线穿进去。

phrase: Tighten it until it is snug.
example: Slide the bonding screw into the hole and tighten it until it is snug.
exampleZh: 把搭接螺丝插入孔中，然后拧到稳固。

phrase: Drill the holes before the wires are in the way.
zh: 趁电线还没挡路先把孔钻好。
example: Drill the holes now, before the wires are in the way.
exampleZh: 现在就把孔钻好，别等电线挡路。

phrase: Secure the cable within twelve inches of the box.
zh: 在距箱体十二英寸内固定电缆。
example: Secure the cable within twelve inches of the box and check the local requirement.
exampleZh: 在距箱体十二英寸内固定电缆，并核对当地要求。

phrase: Get one side started.
example: Get one side started, then pull the strap across the cable.
exampleZh: 先把一边固定起来，再把绑带拉过电缆。

phrase: Pack it into the hole.
example: Pack the duct seal into the hole to make a weather-tight seal.
exampleZh: 把封堵胶泥塞进孔里压实，形成防风雨密封。

phrase: Fish the wires down through the wall.
example: Fish the wires down through the wall and into the connectors.
exampleZh: 把电线向下穿过墙体，再进入接头。

phrase: Place the connector into the slot.
example: Place the connector into the slot with the screws outside the panel.
exampleZh: 把接头放进孔位，螺丝留在配电箱外侧。

phrase: Snap it into place.
example: Use needle-nose pliers and roll it back and forth until it snaps into place.
exampleZh: 用尖嘴钳前后晃动，直到它卡入位。

phrase: Run the knife down the jacket nice and easy.
zh: 用刀轻轻沿着外皮向下划。
example: Run the knife down the jacket nice and easy without pressing hard.
exampleZh: 不要用力压，用刀轻轻沿着外皮向下划。

phrase: Pull the jacket back.
example: After making the cut, pull the jacket back to the connector.
exampleZh: 切开后，把外皮往回拉到接头处。

phrase: Be sure to remove the paper too.
zh: 别忘了也要去掉包装纸。
example: Be sure to remove the paper around the bare ground too.
exampleZh: 别忘了也要去掉裸接地线周围的包装纸。

phrase: Cut away from the wire.
zh: 刀口要远离电线方向切。
example: Cut away from the wire; don't cut toward it.
exampleZh: 刀口要远离电线方向切，不要朝电线切。

phrase: Slide the label back over the wire.
example: Save the labeled jacket and slide it back over the black wire.
exampleZh: 留住带标签的外皮，再把它套回黑线上。

phrase: Be sure to wear safety glasses.
example: Be sure to wear safety glasses when wires are swinging near your face.
exampleZh: 电线在脸旁晃动时，一定要戴护目镜。

phrase: Clip it into place.
example: Line up the breaker and clip it into place.
exampleZh: 对齐断路器，然后把它卡到位。

phrase: Line up the notches.
example: Line up the notches before sliding the breaker over the prongs.
exampleZh: 把断路器滑到插脚上之前，先对齐卡槽。

phrase: Bend the wires into the corner.
example: Bend the wires into the corner, then route them toward the breaker.
exampleZh: 把电线弯到角落里，再引向断路器。

phrase: Rock it out of there.
zh: 轻轻摇动着把它取出来。
example: Pull gently and rock it out of there.
exampleZh: 轻轻往外拉，并摇动着把它取出来。

phrase: Line the wire gauge up with the correct groove.
zh: 把线径对准正确的槽位。
example: Line the wire gauge up with the correct groove on the stripper.
exampleZh: 把线径对准剥线钳上正确的槽位。

phrase: Strip about a quarter inch off.
zh: 剥掉大约四分之一英寸。
example: Use the correct slot and strip about a quarter inch off.
exampleZh: 使用正确槽位，剥掉大约四分之一英寸。

phrase: Reinstall it where you had it.
example: After tightening the conductors, reinstall it where you had it.
exampleZh: 拧紧导线后，把它装回原来的位置。

phrase: Pencil it into the panel schedule.
zh: 用铅笔把它填到配电箱回路表上。
example: As each circuit is installed, pencil it into the panel schedule.
exampleZh: 每安装一个回路，就用铅笔把它填到回路表上。

phrase: Tuck it into the back of the panel.
example: Tuck the neutral into the back of the panel for a neat path.
exampleZh: 把中性线收到配电箱后面，让路径整齐。

phrase: Install the wire in the corresponding slot.
zh: 把电线安装到对应槽位。
example: Check the breaker markings and install the wire in the corresponding slot.
exampleZh: 查看断路器标记，把电线安装到对应槽位。

phrase: Tuck these wires in.
example: Tuck these wires in so everything looks straight and organized.
exampleZh: 把这些电线收进去，让整体看起来笔直整齐。

phrase: Keep them out of the way.
zh: 把它们放到不挡事的地方。
example: Tuck the prepared wires to the side and keep them out of the way.
exampleZh: 把处理好的电线收到侧面，别让它们挡事。

phrase: Fill it out as you go.
example: Keep the panel schedule nearby and fill it out as you go.
exampleZh: 把回路表放在旁边，边做边填写。

phrase: Leave plenty of excess wire.
example: Leave plenty of excess wire in the panel when space allows.
exampleZh: 空间允许时，在配电箱内多留一些余线。

phrase: Give it a little wiggle and re-tighten it.
zh: 轻轻晃一下，然后再拧紧。
example: After snugging the stranded conductor, give it a little wiggle and re-tighten it.
exampleZh: 绞合导线拧紧后，轻轻晃一下，然后再拧紧。

phrase: Wiggle it back and forth and work it out.
zh: 前后晃动，慢慢把它取出。
example: Grip the twist-out with pliers, wiggle it back and forth, and work it out.
exampleZh: 用钳子夹住可拆片，前后晃动，慢慢把它取出。

phrase: Place the screw into the hole and tighten it up.
zh: 把螺丝放进孔里并拧紧。
example: Line up the cover, place the screw into the hole, and tighten it up.
exampleZh: 对齐面板，把螺丝放进孔里并拧紧。

phrase: Lock out the breaker.
example: Lock out the breaker before servicing equipment that is out of sight.
exampleZh: 维修不在视线内的设备前，对断路器上锁隔离。
